title: Lift cooling and mesh-belt transfers between normalising and tempering sections
summary: Suneng's 2026 sample proposal for a mesh-belt normalising and tempering line places forced-cooling fans above an inclined lifting belt. Normalised parts drop into a rapid-cooling unit, then the elevator delivers them to the tempering-furnace inlet. Review cooling dwell and transfer together. Adjustable speed and side guards do not prove stable transfer of every workpiece shape at the same cycle.
coverAlt: Illustration of generic disc-shaped metal blanks
coverCaption: AI-generated illustration of generic metal blanks, not a photograph of this project's workpieces. Actual parts and loading arrangements follow the project documents.
